gotchas: This is the only Energizer device found in the whole sweep with a documented, reachable-without-a-cloud-account local path — and only because 'Smart Life' means Tuya. The vendor names two different apps for the same device (Tuya Smart Life for setup, 'Energizer Solar Portables App' for Bluetooth control). Both appear in the same manual. Recorded rather than resolved.
Peak 300 is 204.8 Wh / 25.6 V / 8 Ah LiFePO4 despite the '300' in the name — the number is the AC watt rating, not the capacity. Do not size a bank off the model number.
US models are 120 V/60 Hz; EU/UK/FR/AU/ZA models are 220-240 V/50-60 Hz. Same model name, different hardware.
Regional availability listed is AU / EU / ZA / US. No Canadian datasheet variant is published.
unmappedReports: per-port output power — the dashboard shows separate figures for each USB outlet, the 12 V car-charger output, and the Anderson output; the contract has only a single load-power, estimated time to FULL charge — the contract has time-to-go (discharge) with no charging counterpart, CO2 emissions avoided, bypass mode vs. inverter mode (AC output sourced from grid vs. from battery), LED torch state — set-switch covers the command, but there is no metric for which of several switchable outputs is on, 'Never off' AC-output setting (keeps output alive through a fridge's power fluctuation)
